content.headline: What you will walk away with today
content.body: Three practical skills for your desk tomorrow — no coding. First, a quick show of hands: personal AI use is common; official use is not. That gap is why this session exists.
bullets: Show of hands: used ChatGPT or similar at least once?
Show of hands: generated an image with AI?
Show of hands: used AI for official work — a draft, translation, or summary?
Then: draft notices in minutes · summarise long files with citations · create outreach media safely
